messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGE — SEV2 detected: elevated 504s from eu-west-3 ELB fronting inference clusters. Alert group: elb-health-checks + route53-weighted-failover. Monitoring: 20% error-rate spike in last 3m. Link: https://ops.redwood/logs/3298765432
infra-oncall: I'm looking. seeing ELB 504 and backend connections timing out, some hosts show repeated ENI detach events in CloudTrail.
networking-sre: Confirming ENI detach spikes — hitting the AZ control plane intermittently. aws console shows a flurry of DetachNetworkInterface events across the AZ.
emma: Customers reporting generation timeouts for hosted-inference in eu-west-3. Which customers are impacted? support-lead: A handful of PLG tenants on that region, plus a couple of enterprise flows with webhook retries. Impact estimate: ~18% of requests failing with 504s.
raj: Quick checks: 
```
# list recent ENI events
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=DetachNetworkInterface --start-time 2026-02-10T10:00:00Z
```
infra-oncall: Running healthchecks against the ELB backends now: `curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" http://10.0.23.45:8080/health` returning 504 from ELB, backend returns 502/connection reset intermittently.
networking-sre: I recommend triggering Route53 failover weights to drain traffic from eu-west-3 to eu-west-1 (our warm failover). Can we do a quick traffic shift to 10% -> 90% within 2m?
emma: Agree, we should shift gradually to avoid cache storms. product-ops: Heads-up to customers via status page and banner. I'll draft a short note.
infra-oncall: Initiating runbook step: adjust Route53 weights to 30/70 (eu-west-3:eu-west-1) now.
raj: Copy, initiating: `aws route53 change-resource-record-sets --change-batch file://shift-30-70.json --hosted-zone-id ZZZ`
incident-bot: Change submitted, change ID: C-ABCD1234. propagation ETA ~60s.
support-lead: Posting to status page: "We are experiencing increased 504 errors in eu-west-3. Traffic is being shifted to eu-west-1 while we investigate." Link to incident channel. :loudspeaker:
networking-sre: Observing immediate drop in errors from targeted ELB subset after weight change, overall request error-rate down to 7% and trending. Good.
emma: Can we also enable ELB connection draining and raise healthy threshold to avoid noisy flaps?
infra-oncall: Enabling deregistration delay to 300s and increasing healthy threshold for target groups to 5 healthy checks. Applying now.
raj: Also scaling up replacement instances in eu-west-3 (spin up fresh ENIs to test behavior isolated from the detached ones): `asg set-desired-capacity --auto-scaling-group-name inference-euw3-asg --desired-capacity 12`
networking-sre: AWS Support (case #987654) looped in. aws-se: I'm on the call with EC2 networking team, they see a controller-plane disruption affecting attach/detach operations in a subset of racks in the AZ. They're running a mitigation sweep.
infra-oncall: Good. For immediate mitigation we have traffic shifted; rolling restarts of nodes could help but avoid mass restart until AWS confirms stability.
emma: Any sign of EBS IO errors too or just ENI detach?
raj: Some EBS io wait increased on two instances but not widespread. looks secondary to network reconnections.
support-lead: Customers on webhook retries seeing duplicated payloads. Recommending transient-failure guidance to SE teams.
product-ops: Status update posted: "Traffic temporarily routed away from eu-west-3; we are monitoring backend health and coordinating with AWS. No data loss; requests may be retried." :information_source:
incident-bot: On-call handoff scheduled: infra-oncall -> networking-sre at +30m. Handoff checklist attached.
networking-sre: I'll stay on for the handoff. AWS SE suggests increasing instance warm pool to reduce churn while control plane stabilizes.
raj: Running continuous log grep for DetachNetworkInterface pattern and correlating instance IDs to ELB target health: `grep -E "DetachNetworkInterface|AssociateEni|AttachNetworkInterface" /var/log/cloud-init.log`
support-lead: Notifying top-five impacted customers directly via email template (draft ready). Emma please review.
emma: Reviewed, minor edits, send now.
infra-oncall: Quick mitigation summary: traffic weight moved -> 30/70 then 10/90 after positive trend; connection draining enabled; ASG warm-up increased; AWS advised a partial control-plane remediation in progress.
networking-sre: AWS reported the control plane sweep completed in the affected segment ~15m ago. We're seeing ENI events tail off. Backends stabilizing, target group healthy counts returning.
incident-bot: Post-mitigation metrics: 504 rate down to 1.5% region-wide; latency back to normal baseline.
support-lead: We're keeping the status banner up until error rate <1% for 30m.
product-ops: Drafting post-incident note and RCA timeline. Assigning follow-up: confirm whether EBS IO blips need separate investigation.
emma: Great job. Next actions: leave failover weight at 90% eu-west-1 for 20m, then gradually move back if no regressions. Schedule postmortem with AWS contact and oncall SREs.
infra-oncall: Acknowledged. handing off to networking-sre for the next 40m. :thumbsup:
